data.title: Nurses for care work in Norway
data.summary: Full-time care work in Norway supporting and treating patients with special support needs. The role can be physically and psychologically demanding.

requirements.text: Suitable education in social or health care
Good stress tolerance and a calm working approach
requirements.question: What does 'good stress tolerance and a calm working approach' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for stress tolerance and calmness without describing the situations where these qualities are needed.

requirements.text: Ability to handle challenging patient situations safely and professionally

requirements.question: What does 'good interpersonal and teamwork skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests interpersonal and teamwork skills but gives no example of how they are used in the role.

requirements.text: Genuine interest in demanding and meaningful care work
requirements.question: What does 'genuine interest in demanding and meaningful care work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for genuine interest in the work without explaining how applicants should demonstrate it.

requirements.text: Experience working with patients who need special support
